description: This is a utility class named DOMHelper designed for handling XML DOM nodes, providing static methods to extract text content and attribute values, with default handling and type conversions.

classes.name: DOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to facilitate XML DOM node manipulation, such as extracting text and attribute values with default fallbacks and type conversions.

methods.name: unmarshallText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates all text content from a given DOM Node by iterating over its child nodes, skipping non-text nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a named attribute from a DOM Node, returning a default if the attribute is absent.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from a DOM Node and converts it to a Double, using a default value if necessary.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from a DOM Node and converts it to an int, using a default if necessary.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from a DOM Node and converts it to a boolean, using a default if necessary.
